messages:
Sam: Flagging NovaTech vendor questionnaire vs DPA mismatch. Their form requires SOC2 evidence + data residency restrictions to EU only. Our DPA currently states standard global processing. Can legal review?
Priya: Do we have a list of what NovaTech will actually send? PII, hashed ids, logs?
Jing (NovaTech): Hi team 1 we only send hashed_user_id, prompts, and some telemetry. No raw PII. Procurement wants SOC2 controls and EU data locality.
Sam: Noted. This could delay onboarding/renewal if procurement holds signature. LegalBot: Created LR-2026-141 and assigned to @Priya for evidence collection and @Sam for customer comms. ETA 48h.
Priya: From ops: pinning to eu region reduces autoscale headroom. I can draft an ops note with perf delta and a small surcharge.
Luca: Security note: We can scope encryption keys to EU at the storage layer for hosted customers, but full BYOK/HSM is only via Dedicated/Private. We'll call that out.
Jing (NovaTech): Procurement insists on BYOK if possible. Is there a quick path?
Luca: Short answer: BYOK requires Dedicated/Private. We can propose scoped EU KMS for hosted as a compromise.
Sam: Plan: 1) Legal to propose an EU-processing addendum, 2) Priya to prep ops delta + pricing, 3) Luca to write security caveats and BYOK fallback. I'll schedule a 30m sync with NovaTech.
Priya: Also request a redacted payload or flow diagram from NovaTech for verification.
Jing (NovaTech): Sharing sanitized flow below:
````
Client -> Redwood API (eu-1) -> model -> cache -> analytics (eu-1)
Fields: hashed_user_id, prompt, response
````
Luca: Good, that helps. I'll update the LR ticket with controls mapping.
LegalBot: Draft addendum posted: https://legal.redwood.internal/LR-2026-141. Please review before the sync.
Sam: Marked renewal watch + sent to renewals. Target: get signable DPA before EOW.
Jing (NovaTech): Thanks  procurement will be on the call.
Sam: Closing loop  will post notes after the call.
